messages:
elaine-marketing: Heads up — final draft of the launch blog is live: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch-draft. Quick ask: can folks sanity-check the hero claim and confirm webinar -> HubSpot registration mapping? Thanks!

mike-growth: LGTM on draft headline but hero claim still reads strong. Can we soften "10x inference" to "up to 10x"? cc @sofia-product

sofia-product: Agree with Mike — our bench used batch=8 and sequence=1k. Recommend "up to 9.8x" or "up to 10x in our tests". We should surface the test config in the appendix.

sam-editor: I can do a quick copy pass tonight. Any preference on CTA phrasing? "Register for live demo" vs "Join launch webinar"?

elaine-marketing: Prefer "Join live demo & product deep-dive" — captures both demo and webinar. Keeps CTAs unified across email + landing.

mike-growth: For UTM + landing mapping: use `utm_source=blog`, `utm_medium=organic`, `utm_campaign=launch_q2`. HubSpot form needs hidden field mapping for `interested_product`. Also recommend `utm_content` for A/B CTA variants.

elaine-marketing: @devops-bot can you paste the HubSpot hidden field snippet we're using for campaign tracking?

devops-bot: Sure — add the following to the registration form template:
```
<input type="hidden" name="utm_source" value="{{utm_source}}">
<input type="hidden" name="utm_campaign" value="launch_q2">
<input type="hidden" name="interested_product" value="redwood-inference">
```

julie-legal: Quick legal pass: avoid absolute comparative claims. Instead of "cheaper than X" please use "lower unit cost in our tests" or "reduced per-token cost in our benchmarks". Also we need a link to the datasheet & test methodology.

sofia-product: Good catch. I'll add an appendix section with the test harness: `model=redwood/base-3b`, `sequence=1024`, `batch=8`, `quant=fp16`, and a short note on variance.

sam-editor: Editing complete. Pushed changes: softened claim, CTA unified to "Join live demo & product deep-dive", added short appendix placeholder. Elaine, can you confirm final approval for publish + webinar ops?

elaine-marketing: ✅ Approved from marketing. @mike-growth please schedule the webinar. We have 250 demo seats reserved; format = 60 min + 15 min Q&A. Assets needed: slide deck + bench appendix PDF + registration page.

mike-growth: Scheduling tentative: Tue May 14, 10:00am PT. I'll create the registration page, wire the HubSpot form, and set seat cap at 250. If registrations >250, route to demo waitlist and send follow-up with on-demand recording.

elaine-marketing: Perfect. Last item: short tweet thread + 2 LinkedIn snippets (product + benchmark callout). Sam, can you draft those?

sam-editor: On it — will post drafts here by EOD tomorrow.

mike-growth: Everything else good from growth side. Will post the live registration link here once it's up and tag ops for Zoom + AV. Tagging thread resolved once assets are live. :rocket:
